source_of_truth: actual gdb runs on a known local C workload

evidence.claim: gdb 18.1 is installed in this environment
debug build with -g -O0 succeeds and file reports debug_info, not stripped
breakpoint at socket_probe stops before doubled is initialized; bt, frame, info locals and print observe state; next advances one source line; continue finishes the process
evidence.command: gdb -q -batch -ex 'set debuginfod enabled off' -ex 'set pagination off' -ex 'break socket_probe' -ex 'run' -ex 'bt' -ex 'frame 0' -ex 'info locals' -ex 'print fd' -ex 'print doubled' -ex 'next' -ex 'print doubled' -ex 'continue' ./debugme

evidence.claim: hardware watchpoint on fd triggers on the write and is deleted when fd leaves scope
evidence.command: gdb -q -batch -ex 'set debuginfod enabled off' -ex 'set pagination off' -ex 'break main' -ex 'run' -ex 'watch fd' -ex 'continue' -ex 'info locals' -ex 'print fd' -ex 'continue' ./debugme

evidence.claim: list, next, step, bt and finish follow a userspace call and return value
evidence.command: gdb -q -batch -ex 'set debuginfod enabled off' -ex 'set pagination off' -ex 'break main' -ex 'run' -ex 'next' -ex 'step' -ex 'bt' -ex 'finish' -ex 'print result' ./debugme

evidence.claim: workload hash pins the exact T1A input
QEMU -s -S with target remote reaches main in the 0.11 runtime fork; kernel source mapping and first instructions are observed
evidence.command: qemu-system-i386 -m 16M -boot a -fda Image -hda hdc-0.11.img -s -S -display none & gdb -q -batch -ex 'set debuginfod enabled off' -ex 'set pagination off' -ex 'file tools/system' -ex 'target remote :1234' -ex 'break main' -ex 'continue' -ex 'bt' -ex 'info registers eip esp eax' -ex 'x/8i $eip' -ex 'info breakpoints'
